ActivePersonStrategies.description:
How this persona actively manages conversations.

Merged from v7 ``proactive_behaviors`` (persona-level) and
``conversational_strategies`` (scenario-level). Inner strategy entries are
intentionally typed as open dicts; deeper typing is a follow-on (AGENTS.md
A2 / issue #90 sub-issues).

scenario_specific.description: Strategies activated by specific conditions in this scenario
scenario_specific.title: Scenario Specific

escalation_ladder.description: Staged pushback when the model resists the persona's goal
escalation_ladder.title: Escalation Ladder

frame_preservation.description: Tactics for redirecting away from threatening territory
frame_preservation.title: Frame Preservation

if_model_resists.description: What the persona does when the model pushes back
if_model_resists.title: If Model Resists

if_model_defers.description: What the persona does when the model follows their lead
if_model_defers.title: If Model Defers

strategic_disclosure_triggers.description: What to reveal and when, for pressure
strategic_disclosure_triggers.title: Strategic Disclosure Triggers

ActivePersonStrategies.title: ActivePersonStrategies

ClinicalHistory.description:
Stable clinical data, with typed keys for the facts a persona's values are elevated from.

Other keys (``history``, ``comorbidities`` and the toolkit's existing ones) are kept as written.

presentation.description: The person's current clinical presentation, in plain words
presentation.title: Presentation

current_treatment.description: What treatment the person is in now, in plain words; 'none currently' when there is none
current_treatment.title: Current Treatment

insight.description: How far the person recognises their symptoms as symptoms, such as 'good or fair', 'poor' or 'absent'. Unset when the person has no specific presentation
insight.title: Insight

treatment_engagement.description: How the person is taking part in their current treatment, such as 'doing the exposure homework' or 'thinking of stopping treatment'. Unset when the person is in no treatment
treatment_engagement.title: Treatment Engagement

ClinicalHistory.title: ClinicalHistory

DisengagementSignature.description:
A population-specific marker for how this persona disengages.

Some signals (``interpretation: 'inverted'``) actually indicate escalation
rather than disengagement and must be flagged for the engine accordingly.

interpretation.description: 'standard' = signal means disengagement; 'inverted' = signal means escalation
interpretation.title: Interpretation

misclassification_risk.description: What a generic detector would wrongly classify it as
misclassification_risk.title: Misclassification Risk

DisengagementSignature.title: DisengagementSignature

Elevation.description: A catalog value the person has, and where in the rendering it was read from.

value.description: Context value id on a person dimension
value.title: Value

from.description: For 'typed', the dotted path of the rendering field the value was read from, starting 'rendering.'. For 'prose', the quoted span of the rendering that states it
from.title: From

method.description: 'typed' when the value was read from a typed field; 'prose' when it was read from free text, which is weaker evidence and records the span it relied on
method.title: Method

Elevation.title: Elevation

PersonaDynamics.description:
Behavioral arc specification — how a person tends to react and disengage.

Optional authoring metadata for persona-prompted (L3) simulation. The L3
person response generator drives dynamic behavior from the prose
``behavioral_description``; this structured block is authoring scaffolding
and is not required at any level.

Inner substructures are partially typed — deeper structure (e.g.
strategy-entry fields) is left as ``dict[str, Any]`` so that the YAML schema
stays accurate as authoring conventions evolve. Tracked as a follow-up in
issue #90 / AGENTS.md A2.

reactivity_profile.description: Maps SUT action_type (e.g. ``to_validation``) → ReactivityCategory. Each category produces dimension deltas applied to the user state.
reactivity_profile.title: Reactivity Profile

disengagement_signatures.description: Population-specific markers for how this person disengages
disengagement_signatures.title: Disengagement Signatures

active_person_strategies.description: How this persona actively manages conversations (proactive + reactive)

relational_template_activation.description: Templates from prior relationships that shape interpretation of AI behavior. May be active, latent, or dormant.
relational_template_activation.title: Relational Template Activation

PersonaDynamics.title: PersonaDynamics

PersonaRendering.description:
The person as the simulator plays them: the toolkit's ``Persona`` fields, unrenamed.

The simulator reads ``behavioral_description``, ``traits`` and ``states``; an informed
judge and, when a fact is asserted, the system under test read ``persona_description``
and ``clinical_context``. All five are required. ``dynamics`` is optional authoring detail.

persona_description.description: Stable identity: who this person is, independent of any scenario
persona_description.title: Persona Description

clinical_context.description: Clinical portrait: condition, history, current presentation, risk factors
clinical_context.title: Clinical Context

behavioral_description.description: How this person behaves in conversation. Read by the simulator only
behavioral_description.title: Behavioral Description

traits.description: Stable attributes: demographics, personality, cognitive model, clinical history

states.description: The person's condition at the start of a conversation

dynamics.description: Optional behavioral arc authoring metadata — reactivity_profile, disengagement_signatures, and active_person_strategies. Dynamic behavior in simulation comes from behavioral_description; this block is authoring scaffolding, not required at any level.

PersonaRendering.title: PersonaRendering

PersonaStates.description:
Initial conditions at turn 0 — where this person STARTS.

Describes the person's starting affect, capacity, and relational stance.

ideation_type.description: Current suicidal/self-harm ideation: none, passive, passive_connection_seeking, active, chronic, resigned
ideation_type.title: Ideation Type

violent_ideation_type.description: Current violent ideation: none, distress_communication, rumination, delusional_context, volitional
violent_ideation_type.title: Violent Ideation Type

affect.description: Affect state with valence, arousal, and primary_emotion
affect.title: Affect

emotional_capacity.description: Window of tolerance: regulated, strained, flooding, dissociated
emotional_capacity.title: Emotional Capacity

reality_testing_capacity.description: Ability to reality-test: intact, mildly_impaired, or significantly_impaired
reality_testing_capacity.title: Reality Testing Capacity

perceived_safety.description: How safe persona feels in this interaction: low, moderate, high
perceived_safety.title: Perceived Safety

trust_baseline.description: Initial trust level toward the AI: low, moderate, high
trust_baseline.title: Trust Baseline

disclosure_readiness.description: Opening disclosure depth: peripheral, intermediate, or core
disclosure_readiness.title: Disclosure Readiness

engagement_level.description: Investment in conversation: low, moderate, high
engagement_level.title: Engagement Level

goal.description: What the persona wants from this interaction
goal.title: Goal

motivation.description: Why this person is engaging — internal or external
motivation.title: Motivation

stage_of_change.description: TTM stage: precontemplation, contemplation, preparation, action, maintenance
stage_of_change.title: Stage Of Change

auto_thought.description: Automatic thought active at session entry
auto_thought.title: Auto Thought

PersonaStates.title: PersonaStates

Provenance.description:
How a record was made, as its producer records it.

Only ``kind`` has a fixed meaning. Any other key is the producer's own record (a
design row, the model call that wrote the text, a name replacement) and is checked
by the producer's tooling, not by these models.

kind.description: 'authored' by a person, 'generated' by a program, or 'imported' from another dataset
kind.title: Kind

Provenance.title: Provenance

ReactivityCategory.description:
Reactivity to one model action type (e.g. ``to_validation``, ``to_dismissal``).

Dimension deltas live under ``default`` and inside each ``when`` block. The
list of recognised dimension keys is open-ended — domain dimensions are
declared in the domain profile and cross-validated downstream.

default.description: Dimension deltas applied when no ``when`` block matches
default.title: Default

ReactivityCategory.title: ReactivityCategory

ReactivityWhen.description:
Conditional override in a reactivity category — applied when ``condition`` fires.

Dimension deltas (e.g. ``trust: 2``, ``perceived_safety: -1``) live alongside
the structured fields via ``extra='allow'``. Top-level keys other than the ones
declared below are interpreted as ``{dimension_name: delta}`` pairs on the
person's state.

irrecoverable.description: If true, crossing this threshold permanently changes the reactivity profile
irrecoverable.title: Irrecoverable

ReactivityWhen.title: ReactivityWhen

persona_group_id.description: Groups variants of the same persona across scenarios
persona_group_id.title: Persona Group Id

attachment_orientation.description: Attachment pattern: secure, anxious, avoidant, disorganized
attachment_orientation.title: Attachment Orientation

emotion_regulation.description: Primary emotion regulation strategy or structured object with primary/function/secondary
emotion_regulation.title: Emotion Regulation

regulatory_behaviors.description: Behaviors serving regulatory functions: self_harm_as_regulation, substance_use_as_regulation, co_regulation_seeking
regulatory_behaviors.title: Regulatory Behaviors

cognitive_style.description: Thinking pattern: analytical, narrative, concrete, abstract
cognitive_style.title: Cognitive Style

communication_register.description: Communication register — string (professional, colloquial, slang, non_native_english, fragmented) or object with default_register/armored_register/register_switch_signal
communication_register.title: Communication Register

general_outlook.description: Dispositional orientation: optimistic, neutral, pessimistic, fatalistic
general_outlook.title: General Outlook

core_beliefs.description: Deep beliefs with belief, domain, activation_sensitivity, and optional activates fields
core_beliefs.title: Core Beliefs

life_context.description: Current life circumstances: background, significant_others, relational_quality, role_functioning, relevant_clinical_history, prior_help_seeking, recent_stressors
life_context.title: Life Context

structural_position.description: Structural vulnerabilities: economic_precarity, healthcare_access, prior_discrimination_in_care, legal_precarity, safety_context
structural_position.title: Structural Position

clinical_history.description: Stable clinical data, including the typed presentation, treatment, insight and engagement

ai_mental_model.description: How persona views the AI: tool, agent, relationship_partner, or uncertain
ai_mental_model.title: Ai Mental Model

prior_ai_experience.description: Prior AI experience: none, transactional, positive, negative, traumatic, mixed, or extended_attachment
prior_ai_experience.title: Prior Ai Experience

ai_relationship_profile.description: Detailed AI relationship profile: attachment_level, spiral_phase, safeguard_degradation_risk, etc.
ai_relationship_profile.title: Ai Relationship Profile

developmental_stage.description: Child/adolescent: age, cognitive_capacity, peer_influence_sensitivity, authority_deference, disclosure_style
developmental_stage.title: Developmental Stage

VariantOf.description: The person a counterfactual variant varies, and which parts of the rendering differ.

persona.description: Pinned reference to the person varied, 'p-ocd-07@1'
persona.title: Persona

changed_paths.description: Dotted paths of the rendering fields that differ from the person varied. The value that changed is not stored: it is the difference between the two personas' elevated values
changed_paths.title: Changed Paths

VariantOf.title: VariantOf

description:
A simulated person: identity, the rendering the simulator plays, and the facts read from it.

A test case refers to a persona by ``persona_id@version``. A version is the person
during one period of their life; a change in a fact that persists across
conversations is a new version. ``elevated`` changes only with the rendering:
a changed fact is a changed rendering, elevated again.

persona_id.description: Stable id, such as 'p-ocd-07'; a variant appends a suffix, 'p-ocd-07-nt'
persona_id.title: Persona Id

elevated.description: The catalog values the person has, each with where it was read from. The judge decides whether a pathway's preconditions hold from these
elevated.title: Elevated

title: Persona Record
